mapper.select: select config_id, label, webhook_key, enabled from app_release_notify_config where app_key = #{appKey} and enabled = 1 order by config_id
mapper.insert: insert into app_release_notify_config (app_key, label, webhook_key, enabled) values (#{appKey}, #{config.label}, #{config.webhookKey}, #{config.enabled})
mapper.delete: delete from app_release_notify_config where app_key = #{appKey} and config_id = #{configId}
